full_text:
The Mud Trap is a magical trap set up by Jodis Lore beneath his tomb in Prague Central Cemetery. It was designed to protect his study, which contained the key for his attic where his Titan, Metagolem, was hidden. The trap consists of a pool of viscous, mud-like substances capable of forming arms that restrain anyone who falls into it, while also preventing the use of magic. It was activated if someone stepped on any clay other than the lighter-drying clay from the Vltava River that was used to create the Golem.

History

An overconfident Lok Lambert fell into Jodis Lore's mud trap upon a rushed attempt to invoke Freelancer against DeFoe and Grier during the team's The Golem of Prague mission. This caused the trap to also consume Sophie Casterwill and Zhalia Moon. Lok attempted to summon Freelancer a second time, but the trap's arms prevented him and held his head under the water. Later, Dante Vale freed them from the trap after tricking DeFoe and taking care of the Suits sent to "dispose" of the Huntik team. [Words of Truth, Heart of Lies]

Abilities

Jodis Lore's mud trap is made of a viscous, mud-like substance that can heavily restrain the individuals stuck inside. Furthermore, the arms it can create can help in hindering that the victim use their magic, namely Titans, by holding their victim's head beneath the mud.[Words of Truth, Heart of Lies]
